subject: On-prem volume anchoring and support tenor
content:
From: Kendra Walsh <kendra.walsh@remedy.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@remedy.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem pricing: volume anchor & support questions

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking a look at this. RemedyAI is planning an on-prem (VPC) deployment and we need to align on the commercial construct before procurement kicks off. High-level ask:

- Target launch: pilot in US (Q3) with fast expansion to EU and APAC in 12 months.
- Expected peak footprint (year 2): ~18 inference GPUs across 3 sites (mixed A100/GPU classes).
- We're evaluating two commercial levers: a platform fee (one-time vs amortized) and per-node licensing, plus a support tier (standard vs premium with 24/7 SRE).

Questions we need answered for our CFO:
1) Can the platform fee be amortized over a multi-year period and treated as a capitalized license? If so, what amortization schedules do you support (12/24/36 months)?
2) Do you offer a volume anchor discount so we can lock a baseline for year 1 and scale up with tiered pricing?
3) Clarify what the premium support SLA contains (P1 response, on-call escalation windows, playbook assistance).

I've attached our SOW template for your legal to review and included Samir from infrastructure. Procurement target is to have terms and a commercial LOI by the end of April.

Appreciate a compact pricing sketch and any precedent you can share.

Best,
Kendra Walsh
Head of Procurement, RemedyAI
procurement@remedy.ai
Attachment: Remedy_SOW_Template.docx (SOW template)

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kendra Walsh <kendra.walsh@remedy.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem pricing: volume anchor & support questions

Hi Kendra — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Looping Marissa (Commercial) and David (Finance) — I'll sketch three pragmatic options you can take to procurement. I attached a concise pricing table (RDW_OnPrem_Tiered_Pricing_v2.pdf) — highlights below.

Quick clarifiers before firm numbers:
- Do you anticipate concurrency-heavy traffic (spiky inference) or relatively steady throughput? That affects batching and node sizing.
- Any regulatory requirement for on-prem backups / air-gapped snapshot support?

Summary (very high level):
- Pilot (short runway): One-time platform fee + per-node month consumption. Platform fee refundable/creditable into committed term.
- Production (recommended): Platform fee amortized (24–36 months) + node license + optional premium support.
- Multisite anchor: Volume anchor (commit) gives a sliding discount on node license and a timebound reduction in platform fee (year 1).

I'll let Marissa provide the specific numbers and David can comment on amortization guidance. We can produce a 1-page LOI for procurement next week.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: RDW_OnPrem_Tiered_Pricing_v2.pdf

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kendra Walsh <kendra.walsh@remedy.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem pricing: volume anchor & support questions

Hi Kendra — appreciate the timeline. Per Evelyn's ask, below are three concrete scenarios (ballpark list rates; we'll lock precise SKUs in the SOW):

1) Pilot (3–6 months)
   - One-time platform onboarding fee: $75,000 (waivable into committed term)
   - Node license: $3,500 / GPU / month (metered)
   - Support: Standard (business hours, ticket-based) included
   - Notes: Good for PoC; not amortized.

2) Production (recommended anchor)
   - Platform fee (amortizable): $300,000. Default amortization support: 12 / 24 / 36 months (customer chooses).
   - Node license: $2,800 / GPU / month at baseline (volume anchor applies)
   - Volume anchor discounts: 10% at 12 GPUs, 18% at 18 GPUs, 25% at 30+ GPUs (applies to node license only)
   - Premium Support add-on: $25,000 / year (24/7 SRE, P1 response <1 hr, runbook playbooks + quarterly reviews)
   - Example: For RemedyAI projected Y2 footprint (18 GPUs) with a 36-month amortization, effective monthly platform amortization = $8,333; node license discount = 18%.

3) Multisite Enterprise (three-region anchor)
   - Platform fee: $450,000 (includes cross-region orchestration features)
   - Node license: $2,500 / GPU / month post-volume discount
   - Support: Premium included for year 1; then optional renewal at listed rate
   - Additional concession: 10% platform fee credit if legal signs within 30 days of LOI

Next steps we recommend: choose amortization term (24 vs 36) and support level; we will then produce an LOI that maps to Remedy's procurement and accounting preferences. I attached the tiered pricing PDF with a simple worksheet.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachment: RDW_OnPrem_Tiered_Pricing_v2.pdf

---
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem pricing: volume anchor & support questions

Team — quick finance note to align with Kendra's CFO expectation:
- Platform fee treatment: We are flexible on amortization but need to lock a schedule in the commercial terms. Standard options are 12/24/36 months; GAAP treatment may vary by customer.
- Proposed internal concession for RemedyAI: allow 40% of platform fee to be amortized over 24 months (if they commit to a 24-month minimum consumption window) and apply a 1-year limited discount on platform of 20% to accelerate sign. This helps their CapEx/OpEx mix while protecting us on revenue recognition.
- Support: premium support is revenue-recognized as a service (OpEx) — we should not amortize it.

If Marissa agrees, we should present the 24-month amortization + 20% year-1 platform discount as the recommended commercial path. Legal to draft LOI with explicit amortization schedule and a consumption minimum.

David Kim
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference

---
From: Kendra Walsh <kendra.walsh@remedy.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@remedy.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem pricing: volume anchor & support questions

Evelyn / Marissa / David — thank you, that was very helpful. RemedyAI's procurement committee is comfortable with the Production scenario with a few asks:

1) Amortization: we accept a 24-month amortization schedule for 40% of the platform fee (per David's suggested path). Remaining platform fee to be payable upfront but creditable into year 2 if we hit the 18 GPU anchor.
2) Discount: 20% off the platform fee for year 1 (applied as a credit on invoice) if LOI is signed by April 30.
3) Support: agree to premium support (will pay the $25k / year) and require explicit P1 playbook and quarterly operational reviews in the SOW.

Please prepare an LOI and updated SOW that reflect: 24-month amortization for 40% of the $300k platform fee, 20% platform credit for year 1 conditional on timely sign, and a premium support addendum. Once we have the LOI I will route to procurement and legal for signature; we can use DocuSign for execution (I pasted a link to our procurement portal).

Thanks again — looking forward to closing before month-end.

Best,
Kendra Walsh
Head of Procurement, RemedyAI
procurement@remedy.ai
Attachments referenced: Remedy_SOW_Template.docx
